before: FIELD 0.8.18 had a useful shared semantic-signal grammar, but renderCatchup projected the global combined CATCH token onto focusHead. A held object could therefore appear CHANGED/REALITY/MIXED because of unrelated state elsewhere in the field.
delta: Derive a route-local semantic token for every addressed FIELD mark.
CHANGED is owned only by that route's unresolved browser-local index-change witness.
REALITY is owned only by an explicit CURRENT human/world gate whose route exactly matches the glyph.
EXTERNAL is owned only when an external issue/witness explicitly names that route; live issue refresh preserves a snapshot route if one exists.
MIXED appears on an addressed glyph only when multiple route-owned source classes coexist.
Project the route-local token onto compact feed glyphs and the held-object header.
Keep CATCH + ACT as a folded global/source-disaggregation summary; remove its global-token spill into focusHead.
Preserve route identity through the held project glyph: lineage remains metadata, not replacement identity.
laws: SIGNAL LOCALITY: PATTERN MAY ONLY CLAIM THE ADDRESS ITS SOURCE NAMES.

verification.source: PENDING CI: signal grammar/locality selftests, project-head glyph selftest, root public contracts, route registration and critical browser smoke.
verification.human: No human gate required. Perceptual usefulness remains revisable: pattern intensity may be reduced without changing token semantics.
verification.limit: External route locality requires an explicit source-side route association; unaddressed GitHub issues remain global and are not guessed onto objects.

next: If locality holds, CATCH can be further contracted because its addressed change/reality meaning now already lives on the field; preserve only source disaggregation and reversible local acknowledgement that has no other owner.
stop: Do not infer route affinity from issue text, recency, title similarity or semantic proximity.
upstream_preserved: FIELD 0.8.18 held-project glyph remains VIEW-only; this pass tightens identity and signal scope without adding another visible block.
